episodes.name: Two equally good cavities: does the swarm split?

Solitary scouts against team-wide NatureSwarm and the coordinator, every team run by Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite: stored episodes, seed 21, of seeds 20 to 22 the one whose scores lie closest to each design's mean over the seeds. Twelve cavities; the best one (cavity A) has a twin of equal quality in the opposite direction (cavity D), every round of waiting costs 5% and a swarm that has not agreed by the last round splits. The solitary scouts had not agreed by the last round and split, 2 of 10 scouts behind cavity A (score 0.12); team-wide NatureSwarm moved into cavity L in round 2 (score 0.76); the coordinator's swarm moved into cavity E in round 2 (score 0.70).

episodes.name: A hunter on the rich flowers
episodes.about: Harder held-out mission forage-risk (eight patches, the two rich ones watched by a hunter), 8 agents per team; these missions were run after the main study, on new seeds. The coordinator against the ant design, every team run by Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite: stored episodes, seed 22, of seeds 20 to 22 the one whose scores lie closest to each design's mean over the seeds. Eight patches; a crab spider hunts on the two rich, conspicuous ones, where a trip fails with probability 0.4 and costs 16 time steps; the safe patches of middle quality are easy to miss. The coordinator brought home 12.6 units and lost 10 of 27 trips to the rich patches; the ant design brought home 14.7 units and lost 7 of 17 trips to the rich patches.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the harder held-out missions, run by a language model after the main study. The mission is run again for this page with every reply taken from the stored decision log (no model is called), so the picture follows the stored episode step by step; the replay must end with the stored result or the page is not written.

subs: one agent reads every report and sends every forager
foragers mark the way to a patch; marks fade
